_comment: Story 1-3. THE single source for name, address and phone (NAP). Nothing may
inline any of these values in a page.
⚠️ THE NAME HAS NO APOSTROPHE, AND THAT IS A DECISION, NOT A TYPO.
Keegan, 2026-07-31, verbatim: 'keegans movement lab is my business name and
should remain that way across all areas.' This closed spec E-1, which had
correctly flagged the apostrophe as an unconfirmed assumption the spec was
It must be spelled IDENTICALLY on every surface: site copy, title tags, schema
name, Google Business Profile, Foursquare, Bing Places, Instagram. Cross-source
name consistency IS the mechanism Google uses to connect the profile to the
site, and that connection is why story 1-5 exists — Google REJECTED Keegan's
profile edits for lack of corroboration. A one-character mismatch is therefore
worse than an absence. Do not 'correct' this to an apostrophe form.
⚠️ AHPRA s133: no field for a review, a rating or a testimonial exists in this
file, by design. Structural, not remembered — a field that does not exist
cannot be filled in. check-data.mjs walks the KEYS and asserts the absence,
name: Keegans Movement Lab
legalNote: Practises from Restore Health Clinic, which is a separate business with its own Cliniko account.
phoneNote: This is the NAP number and matches the Google Business Profile. The current website also shows 0451 782 249 described as 'call the clinic' — that is Restore Health Clinic's line, NOT the NAP number, and must not be used in schema or the footer. [ASSUMED from Vigil's measurement that the profile carries 0403 887 360; Keegan has not contradicted it, but it is worth one glance at the profile before 1-5 ships.]
geoNote: DELIBERATELY NULL, not forgotten. Spec G-8 wants a geo node on the MedicalBusiness schema, but inventing coordinates for a real clinic address would be fabricating a fact that sends people to a physical location. Needs a real lookup (Google Maps 'copy coordinates' on the pin, or a geocoder) before 1-5 emits it. 1-5 must OMIT the geo node while this is null rather than guess.
sameAsNote: Spec G-8 wants the Google Business Profile URL and Instagram here — sameAs is a strong entity signal and the profile link is what ties the two together. Neither URL is recorded in any project artifact. Needs Keegan before 1-5.
ahpraNote: Emitted as an identifier on the Physician node on /about/ (spec G-8), never as a marketing claim.
